F50.quote: The absorption features are consistent with the expected OH level population due to the heliocentric velocity of the comet.
F50.claim: absorption consistent with the level population set by the heliocentric velocity

F51.quote: The detection of OH on 24 October 2025 contrasts with the MeerKAT non-detection of these lines on 20 September 2025 from 14:36:54-15:39:25 UTC (rms noise of 3 mJy/beam) and 28 September 2025 from 10:00:26-16:55:53 UTC (rms noise of 1 mJy/beam).

F52.quote: Further MeerKAT observations of 1665/1667 MHz OH in absorption and emission, and a technosignature search in 3I/ATLAS

F53.quote: We detected both the 1665 MHz and 1667 MHz OH lines in absorption on 5 November from UTC 03:54:29-05:48:05 and again on 6 November from UTC 03:50:22-11:23:46.
F53.claim: both lines in absorption on 5 and 6 November

F54.quote: Consistent with the expected OH level population due to the heliocentric velocity of the comet, we then detected the OH lines in emission on 11 November from UTC 04:11:20-07:31:01 and 12 November from UTC 03:06:42-05:42:55.
F54.claim: the lines in emission on 11 and 12 November, as the level population predicts

F55.quote: These velocities are consistent with the expected velocity of the comet.

F56.quote: These detections contrast to the non-detection by MeerKAT of either OH line on 4 November from UTC 04:12:55-11:45:12 with an rms noise of 1.1 mJy/beam.

F57.quote: A total of 23,689 signals were detected; however, all were determined to not be spatially consistent with the position of 3I/ATLAS and thus were likely caused by anthropogenic radio frequency interference (RFI).
